messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi James. Still nothing shipped. Your B30 is waiting on batch 1 to check in at our Chattanooga warehouse; your free Power K. is already reserved there and goes in the same box. You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The date on the order was October 15 and it has passed, so I'm sorry. I won't give you a new one I can't stand behind. Tracking comes to this email as soon as the label prints.
